Markets.title: Dalal Street Week Ahead: Nifty bulls come back to life, but 25,000–25,200 zone poses next test
Markets.summary: Indian equity markets rallied significantly and reclaimed important moving averages following favorable US election results. The Nifty Index faces its next test as it approaches broader resistance levels between 25,000 and 25,200.

Markets.title: Concurrent Gainers: 9 stocks gain for 5 days in a row
Markets.summary: Amid an 8.82% market rally from November 2 to 6, nine BSE 200 stocks posted consecutive gains for five straight sessions. These advancing stocks delivered individual returns ranging from 14% to 19% over the period.

Markets.title: Wall Street grapples with $5.7 trillion rout as AI bets unwind
Markets.summary: Wall Street experienced a $5.7 trillion sell-off as investors reevaluated the viability and high valuations of artificial intelligence infrastructure investments. Market anxieties were further amplified by political developments and potential regulatory challenges from a Democratic majority in Congress.

Markets.summary: Brokerage firm Angel One has selected seven stocks across various sectors for potential investment ahead of Samvat 2083. The recommended equities offer up to 50% upside potential based on their expected earnings growth.

Markets.title: Dollar jumps after strong US payrolls report
Markets.summary: The US dollar index rose significantly after the Labor Department reported that job growth exceeded economists' forecasts last month. This strong report increased the probability of a Federal Reserve rate hike to nearly 80 percent and caused other currencies to decline.

Geo-Political.title: What we know about Krakow mass shooting so far
Geo-Political.summary: At least six people were killed in a mass shooting in Krakow, Poland's second-largest city. The gunman wore military fatigues and opened fire on the victims.

Geo-Political.title: No clear winner after tight New Zealand general election
Geo-Political.summary: Preliminary results from New Zealand's general election show a deeply divided national parliament with no clear winner. The political deadlock means that weeks of coalition negotiations are expected to follow.

Geo-Political.title: US offers $20m reward for information about Iran's nuclear programme
Geo-Political.summary: The United States has offered a $20 million reward for information regarding Iran's nuclear program. This comes as Donald Trump repeatedly raises the prospect of renewing strikes against Iranian nuclear facilities.

Geo-Political.title: Houthis say at least 25 killed in Saudi air strike
Geo-Political.summary: Houthis report that a Saudi-led coalition air strike in Yemen killed at least 25 people. The Saudi-led coalition has not yet commented on the incident.

Geo-Political.title: UK cannot 'cherry pick' EU single market deal, Barnier tells BBC
Geo-Political.summary: Former Brexit negotiator Michel Barnier stated that the UK cannot choose which EU single market rules to follow. He explained that EU member states would reject any such "a la carte" economic deal.

Geo-Political.title: With Stephen Miller pick, Trump readies for a battle
Geo-Political.summary: President Trump has appointed loyal partisan Stephen Miller as his new chief of staff. This selection is expected to trigger significant political conflicts with Congress.

AI & Tech.summary: An author tested asking ChatGPT for SaaS WordPress course recommendations and found their course was recommended first without paid advertising. This demonstrated a shift from traditional search engine optimization (SEO) to AI optimization (AIO) for organic traffic.

Data & Insights.title: The midterms give Fed more room to raise rates, mut maybe less reason to do so
Data & Insights.summary: Midterm election results suggest a slowdown in datacenter spending. This reduction in spending could help curb inflation and influence Federal Reserve interest rate decisions.

Data & Insights.title: No fresh curbs on broken rice exports as India banks on steady paddy procurement
Data & Insights.summary: India, the world's largest rice exporter, shipped 8.08 lakh tonnes of broken rice in calendar year 2025. The government will not impose fresh export curbs on broken rice due to steady paddy procurement, maintaining the policy since lifting a previous ban on March 7, 2025.

Data & Insights.title: Bond yield rise squeezes banks' Q2 treasury gains
Data & Insights.summary: A sharp rise in bond yields caused public and private banks to report treasury losses during the second quarter. These elevated yields could continue to pressure bank earnings in the upcoming December quarter.

Data & Insights.title: Internship scheme's new pilot gets more takers post rejig
Data & Insights.summary: About 40,000 candidates have joined the third pilot round of the PM Internship Scheme, which is 2.5 times the turnout of the first two rounds. This positive response has encouraged the corporate affairs ministry to launch the full programme next year without additional pilots.

Data & Insights.title: India gets Strait of Hormuz passage reprieve from Iran. What does Tehran expect in return?
Data & Insights.summary: Iran is allowing Indian ships to pass through the Strait of Hormuz to secure essential medicines, energy supplies, and diplomatic support. In exchange, Tehran expects continued trade, diplomatic backing, and the maintenance of economic ties despite international sanctions.

Data & Insights.title: Food accounts for 53.5% of rural household spending as inflation rises: NABARD survey
Data & Insights.summary: A NABARD survey shows that food accounts for 53.5% of rural household spending amid rising inflation. This high cost of food is increasing financial strain by eroding rural savings and driving up borrowing.

India.title: Mamata Banerjee, BJP Trade Charges Over 'Attack' On Abhishek Banerjee's Home
India.summary: An alleged attack on Trinamool Congress leader Abhishek Banerjee's residence has sparked a political clash in West Bengal. West Bengal Chief Minister Mamata Banerjee and the BJP have traded accusations regarding the incident.

India.title: Anti-Drug Activist Shot At By Gang In Punjab's Barnala
India.summary: An anti-drug activist named Amandeep Singh was shot by a gang in Barnala, Punjab. He was hospitalized and later transferred to a super-speciality facility for treatment.

India.title: Why Week After Diwali Will Be Delhi's Biggest Pollution Test
India.summary: Delhi faces a major public health crisis in the week following Diwali. This severe pollution is driven by multiple factors rather than just firecrackers.

India.title: Drunk Man Kills Friend In Pune, Chops Off His Legs, Dumps Them In Trash
India.summary: A drunk man in Pune murdered his friend on Friday in the Pimple Gurav area. Police arrested the accused, Pintya alias Vishnu Tanaji Kumbhar, after he chopped off the victim's legs and dumped them in the trash.

India.title: "Fake": RBI Dismisses Claims Of New Cheque Book Rules From January
India.summary: The Reserve Bank of India has dismissed social media claims that standard cheque book rules will change starting January. The central bank confirmed that messages stating current cheque books under the Cheque Truncation System will expire by December 31, 2026, are fake.

India.title: 'Ignore, See Consequences': IndiGo Flight Returns To Bengaluru After Hijack Threat Note Found In Toilet
India.summary: An IndiGo flight from Bengaluru to Lucknow returned to Bengaluru after a handwritten threat note was discovered in the aircraft's toilet. A passenger found the note and alerted the crew, prompting the flight's return.

General.title: What we know about Krakow mass shooting so far
General.summary: A gunman wearing military fatigues killed at least six people in Poland's second largest city, Krakow. The mass shooting is currently under investigation by local authorities.

General.title: UK cannot 'cherry pick' EU single market deal, Barnier tells BBC
General.summary: Former Brexit negotiator Michel Barnier stated the UK cannot select parts of the EU single market to join. He explained that EU member states would reject any British attempts to follow economic rules on an "a la carte" basis.

General.title: Andy Burnham wants to get closer to the EU - but he shouldn't expect a smooth ride
General.summary: Laura Kuenssberg reports that the prime minister has initiated discussions about the UK rejoining the European Union. Andy Burnham supports moving closer to the EU, but government insiders warn he will face significant challenges.

General.title: Tens of thousands of tents flooded after heavy rains in Gaza
General.summary: Heavy rains in Gaza have flooded tens of thousands of temporary tents sheltering displaced Palestinians. The flooding worsened living conditions for those displaced by the ongoing war between Israel and Hamas.

General.title: 'Dana, please take the job!' - Trump asks UFC boss to be White House press secretary
General.summary: The BBC has asked the White House and TKO Holdings, the parent company of UFC, for comment.
